text_block_list.text:
While walking with K.S.Miracle
on our way to the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm fine.
I just stumbled a little.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...My legs have been getting tangled up a lot lately.
Maybe I'm just a little tired..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, why am I whining like this?
I'm sorry! Please forget what I just said.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm feeling just fine. Looking forward to today's training as always!

It seems K.S.Miracle is still feeling fatigued from the race.
It might be best to reconsider our upcoming race schedule...
